insert_code: const PROVIDER_URL=window.location.origin;const STORAGE_KEYS={CUSTOMER_ID:'walue_customer_id',CUSTOMER_DATA:'walue_customer_data',SESSION_ID:'walue_session_id'};let customerData=null;let FB_APP_ID=null;let FB_CONFIG_ID=null;async function apiCall(endpoint,method,data){const url=PROVIDER_URL+'/api/method/'+endpoint;const options={method:method,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}};if(data&&method!=='GET')options.body=JSON.stringify(data);const response=await fetch(url,options);const result=await response.json();return result.message||result}function saveCustomerData(data){localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOMER_DATA,JSON.stringify(data));if(data.customer_id)localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOMER_ID,data.customer_id)}function getCustomerData(){const data=localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOMER_DATA);return data?JSON.parse(data):null}function clearCustomerData(){localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOMER_DATA);localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOMER_ID);localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SESSION_ID)}function logout(){clearCustomerData();window.location.href='/walue'}function showToast(message,type){const toast=document.createElement('div');toast.className='toast '+type;toast.innerHTML=''+message;document.body.appendChild(toast);setTimeout(function(){toast.classList.add('show')},10);setTimeout(function(){toast.classList.remove('show');setTimeout(function(){toast.remove()},300)},3000)}function formatDate(dateString){if(!dateString)return'-';const date=new Date(dateString);return date.toLocaleDateString()+' '+date.toLocaleTimeString()}function copyToClipboard(elementId){const element=document.getElementById(elementId);if(element){navigator.clipboard.writeText(element.value).then(function(){showToast('Copied to clipboard!','success')})}}function copySetupToken(){copyToClipboard('setup-token')}function copySetupLink(){copyToClipboard('setup-link')}function copyInstallCommands(){const commands=document.getElementById('install-commands').innerText;navigator.clipboard.writeText(commands).then(function(){showToast('Commands copied!','success')})}document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',async function(){customerData=getCustomerData();if(!customerData||!customerData.customer_id){document.getElementById('no-customer-alert').style.display='block';document.getElementById('dashboard-content').style.display='none';return}document.getElementById('no-customer-alert').style.display='none';document.getElementById('dashboard-content').style.display='block';document.getElementById('customer-name-nav').textContent=customerData.customer_name;await loadFacebookConfig();initFacebookSDK();setupSessionInfoListener();await updateDashboardStatus()});async function loadFacebookConfig(){try{const result=await apiCall('walue_whatsapp_provider.api.embedded_signup.get_config','GET');if(result.success){FB_APP_ID=result.app_id;FB_CONFIG_ID=result.config_id}}catch(error){console.error('Failed to load Facebook config:',error)}}function initFacebookSDK(){if(!document.getElementById('facebook-jssdk')){const script=document.createElement('script');script.id='facebook-jssdk';script.src='https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/sdk.js';script.async=true;script.defer=true;script.crossOrigin='anonymous';document.head.appendChild(script)}window.fbAsyncInit=function(){if(FB_APP_ID){FB.init({appId:FB_APP_ID,autoLogAppEvents:true,xfbml:true,version:'v24.0'})}}}function setupSessionInfoListener(){window.addEventListener('message',function(event){if(event.origin!=='https://www.facebook.com'&&event.origin!=='https://web.facebook.com')return;try{const data=JSON.parse(event.data);if(data.type==='WA_EMBEDDED_SIGNUP'){if(data.event==='FINISH'||data.event==='FINISH_ONLY_WABA'){window.embeddedSignupWabaData=data.data;if(window.embeddedSignupCode||window.embeddedSignupAccessToken){handleEmbeddedSignupComplete(data.data)}}else if(data.event==='CANCEL'){showToast('WhatsApp signup was cancelled','info');resetConnectButton()}else if(data.event==='ERROR'){showToast('Error during signup','error');resetConnectButton()}}}catch(e){}})}async function handleEmbeddedSignupComplete(data){const wabaId=data.waba_id;const phoneNumberId=data.phone_number_id;const sessionId=localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SESSION_ID);const code=window.embeddedSignupCode;const accessToken=window.embeddedSignupAccessToken;if(!wabaId){showToast('Failed to get WhatsApp Business Account ID','error');resetConnectButton();return}try{showToast('Completing signup...','info');const result=await apiCall('walue_whatsapp_provider.api.embedded_signup.complete','POST',{customer_id:customerData.customer_id,session_id:sessionId,waba_id:wabaId,phone_number_id:phoneNumberId,code:code||null,access_token:accessToken||null});if(result.success){showToast('WhatsApp connected successfully!','success');customerData.waba_id=wabaId;customerData.phone_number_id=phoneNumberId;customerData.embedded_signup_completed=true;customerData.phone_number=result.phone_number;customerData.setup_token=result.setup_token;saveCustomerData(customerData);window.embeddedSignupCode=null;window.embeddedSignupAccessToken=null;window.embeddedSignupWabaData=null;await updateDashboardStatus();resetConnectButton()}else{showToast(result.error||'Failed to complete signup','error');resetConnectButton()}}catch(error){showToast('Failed to complete signup','error');resetConnectButton()}}function resetConnectButton(){const btn=document.querySelector('#waba-action button');if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.innerHTML='Connect WhatsApp'}}async function updateDashboardStatus(){updateCustomerDetails();const siteUrl=customerData.frappe_site_url||'';const siteDomain=siteUrl.replace('https://','').replace('http://','').replace(/\/$/,'');document.getElementById('site-placeholder').textContent=siteDomain||'your-site.com';updateStatusCard('registration',true,'Complete');const wabaConnected=customerData.waba_id||customerData.embedded_signup_completed;if(wabaConnected){updateStatusCard('waba',true,'Connected');document.getElementById('waba-badge').className='step-badge complete';document.getElementById('waba-badge').textContent='Complete';document.getElementById('waba-action').style.display='none';document.getElementById('waba-completed').style.display='block';document.getElementById('waba-phone').textContent=customerData.phone_number||'N/A';document.getElementById('step-install-number').className='step-number active';document.getElementById('step-configure-number').className='step-number active';await loadSetupInfo()}else{updateStatusCard('waba',false,'Not Connected');document.getElementById('waba-badge').className='step-badge pending';document.getElementById('waba-badge').textContent='Pending'}const setupUsed=customerData.setup_token_used;if(setupUsed){updateStatusCard('app',true,'Configured');document.getElementById('configure-badge').className='step-badge complete';document.getElementById('configure-badge').textContent='Complete'}else{updateStatusCard('app',false,'Not Configured');document.getElementById('configure-badge').className='step-badge pending';document.getElementById('configure-badge').textContent='Pending'}}function updateStatusCard(type,success,text){const iconEl=document.getElementById(type+'-status-icon');const textEl=document.getElementById(type+'-status-text');if(success){iconEl.className='status-icon complete';iconEl.innerHTML=''}else{iconEl.className='status-icon pending';iconEl.innerHTML=''}textEl.textContent=text}function updateCustomerDetails(){document.getElementById('detail-customer-id').textContent=customerData.customer_id||'-';document.getElementById('detail-customer-name').textContent=customerData.customer_name||'-';document.getElementById('detail-email').textContent=customerData.company_email||'-';document.getElementById('detail-site-url').textContent=customerData.frappe_site_url||'-';document.getElementById('detail-plan').textContent=customerData.subscription_plan||'-';document.getElementById('detail-status').textContent=customerData.status||'Pending'}async function loadSetupInfo(){try{const sessionId=localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SESSION_ID);const params=sessionId?'session_id='+sessionId:'customer_id='+customerData.customer_id;const result=await apiCall('walue_whatsapp_provider.api.setup.get_setup_info?'+params,'GET');if(result.success){if(result.setup_token&&!result.setup_token_used){document.getElementById('setup-token').value=result.setup_token;document.getElementById('setup-link').value=result.setup_link||'';document.getElementById('setup-link-btn').href=result.setup_link||'#';document.getElementById('token-expiry').textContent=formatDate(result.setup_token_expiry)}else if(result.setup_token_used){document.getElementById('setup-token').value='Token already used';document.getElementById('setup-link').value='Token already used';document.getElementById('token-used-warning').style.display='block'}customerData=Object.assign({},customerData,{phone_number:result.phone_number,waba_id:result.waba_id,setup_token_used:result.setup_token_used});saveCustomerData(customerData)}}catch(error){console.error('Failed to load setup info:',error)}}async function initiateEmbeddedSignup(){const btn=event.target;btn.disabled=true;btn.innerHTML=' Loading...';if(typeof FB==='undefined'){showToast('Facebook SDK not loaded','error');resetConnectButton();return}if(!FB_APP_ID||!FB_CONFIG_ID){showToast('Configuration not loaded','error');resetConnectButton();return}try{const initResult=await apiCall('walue_whatsapp_provider.api.embedded_signup.initiate','POST',{customer_id:customerData.customer_id});if(!initResult.success){showToast(initResult.error||'Failed to start signup','error');resetConnectButton();return}localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SESSION_ID,initResult.session_id);FB.login(function(response){if(response.authResponse){window.embeddedSignupCode=response.authResponse.code||null;window.embeddedSignupAccessToken=response.authResponse.accessToken||null;if(window.embeddedSignupWabaData){handleEmbeddedSignupComplete(window.embeddedSignupWabaData)}else{showToast('Processing...','info');setTimeout(function(){if(!window.embeddedSignupWabaData&&!customerData.embedded_signup_completed){showToast('Please refresh the page','info');resetConnectButton()}},30000)}}else{showToast('Login cancelled','error');resetConnectButton()}},{config_id:FB_CONFIG_ID,response_type:'code',override_default_response_type:true,extras:{version:'v3'}})}catch(error){showToast('Connection error','error');resetConnectButton()}}
